QF.id: SIA Assessment Frameworks Techniques and Standards_21

question.text: Pragati Foundation's literacy program runs in the same district where the State government also runs the Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan. Ms. Sunita Patil (SIA) wants to evaluate what share of literacy improvement is due to the Foundation rather than the state scheme. Which concept-pair best describes her analysis?

answer.text: Drop-off analysis — measuring fade of outcome over time
Displacement analysis — measuring jobs lost due to the Foundation
Materiality analysis — ranking which outcomes matter most
Attribution analysis — isolating the SE's specific share of outcome when multiple actors contribute

explanation.text: The Logic: Attribution analysis determines what share of an observed outcome can be causally credited to the SE's intervention when other actors (government, other NGOs, secular trends) are also contributing. In SROI, an attribution % is deducted from gross outcome, reducing the Impact Value. The Trap: Displacement = outcome at another group's expense. Materiality = importance ranking. Drop-off = temporal fade. Only attribution addresses the 'who gets credit' question when multiple actors co-deliver. Cross-Exam Context: X-A IA uses attribution in investment performance; XV Research Analyst uses it in multi-factor returns. XXIII applies the same label to social outcomes under SROI/IMP CONTRIBUTION. Assessor's Pro-Tip: When a state scheme overlaps, get the district education officer's enrolment dataset as your attribution evidence — triangulating SE records with government baselines is the cleanest way to apportion credit.
